thread:
maria: proposing a new canary schedule for the model v3 rollout. want to balance fast ramp for capacity savings with strong guardrails. pasted a draft config below — feedback?

maria: ```json
{
  "strategy": "staggered_percent",
  "steps": [
    {"percent": 1, "hold_minutes": 30},
    {"percent": 5, "hold_minutes": 30},
    {"percent": 15, "hold_minutes": 45},
    {"percent": 40, "hold_minutes": 60},
    {"percent": 100, "hold_minutes": 10}
  ],
  "guards": {
    "error_rate_pct": 0.5,
    "p95_latency_increase_pct": 20,
    "throughput_drop_pct": 30
  },
  "backoff_on_guard": "rollback",
  "sticky_affinity": true
}
```

tariq: overall looks reasonable. couple thoughts: 1) first two steps might be too long for low-traffic models — we could make first hold 10m for safekeeping. 2) consider an automatic retry window instead of immediate rollback (eg. pause + try again once).

jen: +1 on pause/retry. also we need explicit per-customer caps — some enterprise tenants can't see anything <100% until approval. how do we represent that?

kevin: we already have tenancy routing tags in the routing policy. config could accept a "overrides" map keyed by customer_id. eg: 
```yaml
overrides:
  cust-42:
    allow_canary: false
  cust-99:
    start_percent: 5
```

maria: good call. will add overrides. on the pause vs rollback debate: proposal — default to pause + notify, allow auto-rollback if error_rate > 2.0% or p95 increase > 50%. keep the softer guards for pause.

sre-oncall: telemetry needs to be actionable. two asks: 1) ensure we emit per-step events to /metrics/rollouts (labels: model, step_idx, percent, outcome). 2) add an alert rule: sustained step pause > 15m => pager to oncall.

devops-bot: reminder: deployment quota checks run at step transitions. if quota_exceeded => step will queue and send notification.

deploy-bot: triggered canary job created: job_id=cb-2026-03-18-01; starting step 0 (1% for 30m).

tariq: UI notes — console should show the forecasted traffic curve and expected token volume per step. people get scared when % jumps from 15 to 40 without cost impact shown. also allow editing hold_minutes inline during an active rollout.

jen: UX: prefer a small "preview" mode that simulates metric deltas from previous rollouts for the same model family. helps product decide if ramp is too aggressive.

kevin: edge case — if a model variant has quantization profile that increases p95 at low concurrency only, our p95 guard might fire at 1% due to cold-starts. recommend adding warmup ramp flag: "min_warmup_requests": 2000.

maria: will add warmup_requests and make first step dynamic: min(1%, baseline_traffic_pct * 0.01) to avoid tiny absolute volume skews.

sre-oncall: one more: we need a canary sandbox route for smoke tests (no production traffic) for quick healthchecks prior to step 0. makes rollback decisions less noisy.

maria: sound plan. I'll update the API schema and console mockups. PR to follow with API examples and dashboard panels paths (/console/models/{model}/rollouts). thanks all. :rocket:

kevin: thanks — will add the quota/override proto for platform routing.

deploy-bot: job cb-2026-03-18-01 updated: step 0 completed (healthy), progressing to step 1 (5%).
